rules.single_retention: all three direct annual deltas strictly below -near_score
rules.single_deletion: all three direct annual deltas strictly above near_score
rules.uncertain: incomplete, near annual effect or mixed direction; context conditional
rules.probe: min annual delta >= -near_score, mean annual delta > near_score, 2023 delta > near_score
rules.joint: 2023 delta > near_score, mean annual delta > 0, min annual delta >= -clear_year_degradation, every year above baseline10
rules.ranking: 2023 official score descending; ties within 1e-12: worst yearly delta vs baseline10, mean yearly score descending, feature count ascending, candidate ID ascending
